title: Piggy Bank Bug Hunt
body:
Goal: find and fix the 3 bugs in the PiggyBank class. When it works, Run prints:

Comet has 0 coins
1. in 10
2. in 5
3. out 15

How to hunt: press Run and compare with the expected output. Then use Debug and Step over to watch self.coins and self.log in the Variables view. Write each bug you find on your homework sheet (line number, what was wrong, how you fixed it).

hints.label: Hint 1
hints.title: Where to look
hints.html: Run it and compare the output with the expected output. Check the coins line first, then count the lines under it. Each of the three bugs is in a different method.

hints.label: Hint 2
hints.title: Try this
hints.html: Use Debug and Step over, and watch self.coins and self.log in the Variables view. After the first deposit, and again after the second, ask whether the total is what you expect. Then check whether taking out all the coins works.

hints.label: Hint 3
hints.title: Almost there
hints.html: Check three spots. In deposit, follow self.coins after each deposit: is the total what you expect? In withdraw, test the sign in amount >= self.coins with exactly all the coins. In statement, check which log lines range(len(self.log) - 1) skips.

starter.name: starter.py
starter.raw:
# Homework 6: Piggy Bank Bug Hunt
# This class has 3 bugs. Use Run, the error/output and the Thonny debugger.
# Expected output when fixed:
#   Comet has 0 coins
#   1. in 10
#   2. in 5
#   3. out 15


class PiggyBank:
    """A savings bank for game coins that keeps a log of every change."""

    def __init__(self, owner_nickname):
        self.owner = owner_nickname
        self.coins = 0
        self.log = []

    def deposit(self, amount):
        """Put coins in. Return False for 0 or negative amounts."""
        if amount <= 0:
            return False
        self.coins = amount
        self.log.append(f"in {amount}")
        return True

    def withdraw(self, amount):
        """Take coins out. You can take everything, but never more."""
        if amount <= 0 or amount >= self.coins:
            return False
        self.coins = self.coins - amount
        self.log.append(f"out {amount}")
        return True

    def statement(self):
        """Return numbered log lines, like '1. in 10'."""
        lines = []
        for i in range(len(self.log) - 1):
            lines.append(f"{i + 1}. {self.log[i]}")
        return lines


if __name__ == "__main__":
    bank = PiggyBank("Comet")
    bank.deposit(10)
    bank.deposit(5)
    bank.withdraw(15)
    print(f"{bank.owner} has {bank.coins} coins")
    for line in bank.statement():
        print(line)
